messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: High inference tail latency detected on /v1/generate (p50 p95 p99 spike). Auto-notify to #eng-oncall. link: https://alerts.redwood.local/INC-2026-1755012345 :rotating_light:
arya_oncall: i'm on it, paging now. observed customer 503s reported from session logs. starting live triage. :eyes:
mike_infra: oncall here — checking infra metrics, pushing logs to #incident-assets. can someone confirm customer impact?
sre_lead_jess: i'm joining. quick ask: any recent deploys to runtime in last 30m?
ml_runtime_lee: no deploys from runtime team. saw a burst of long requests queued in the autoscale queue around T-6m. HPA scaled but pods stuck in Pending for ~90s.
arya_oncall: customer support: 4 customers reported elevated error rates, one is doing sync generation (high qps). marking P1 degraded.
mike_infra: grabbing k8s events: ```kubectl get events -n runtime --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 30
...
Warning  FailedScheduling  2m (x5 over 6m)  default-scheduler  0/10 nodes are available: 10 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
```
ml_runtime_lee: that matches: GPU pool saturated. cold start warmup latency for new GPU pods measured ~70s because image pull + model warmup + kv-cache init. warmup backlog causing queue depth to grow.
sre_lead_jess: hypothesis 1: pool saturation due to burst of large-model requests + HPA reacting too late. hypothesis 2: image pulls/registry throttle increased startup time. need logs from registry and node metrics.
ops_rotation_noah: running: `kubectl top nodes` and `gcloud compute instances list` — 3 nodes showing >98% GPU utilization, 2 nodes in preemptible pool started but not yet joined runtime ASG.
mike_infra: I triggered a targeted scale up of the dedicated-gpu ASG (+3 nodes) to relieve scheduling backlog. patch command: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize redwood-gpu-ig --size=13`
arya_oncall: deploying temporary routing rule to prefer smaller model variant for non-enterprise customers to reduce GPU footprint. config PR: `routing/overrides/2026-1755` will route model:large -> model:med for anonymous tier. :pushpin:
ml_runtime_lee: after routing change, queue depth reduced from 120 -> 30 in 90s. p95 latency improved but p99 still elevated for long-run sessions.
sre_lead_jess: we should also disable HPA cool-down (shorten) for next 10m to react faster. mike, can you adjust HPA thresholds?
mike_infra: lowering hpa.scaleUp.delay to 30s and minReplicas from 2->4 for runtime-large pool. applying now.
cto_tara: what's customer-facing status? any SRE note to support for messages?
arya_oncall: sending status update: "We're mitigating elevated latency for generation API by routing to lower-cost model variants and scaling up GPU pool. Expect improvements in 10-20 minutes. Investigating root cause"
ops_rotation_noah: registry logs show sporadic 503s to mirror-registry around the burst window. suspected registry throttling added ~20s to pod startup (image pulls).
ml_runtime_lee: combining evidence: (1) request burst created scheduling demand, (2) HPA scale events lagged because metrics averaged over 60s, (3) registry pull + model warmup increased pod readiness by ~70s -> effective autoscale delay ~130s causing queue to pile and GPU saturation.
sre_lead_jess: agreed. interim mitigations: +ASG nodes, routing fallback, HPA cooldown reduction. next: collect kubelet logs, registry timeouts, and pod-start traces for RCA. assign owners: mike infra -> node/ASG/registry traces, lee -> model warmup trace + KV cache init, arya -> customer impact & status.
mike_infra: fetching logs and uploading to incident-assets: https://assets.redwood.local/incident/1755012345/logbundle.tar.gz (contains node events, autoscaler events, registry logs)
arya_oncall: support notified. two impacted customers have temporary workaround applied (route to med model). no data leak, no request body loss.
cto_tara: good mitigation. what TTR estimate?
sre_lead_jess: estimating TTR 20-30m until pool fully healthy and residual tail clears. will update. also tagging this for post-incident RCA and capacity policy change.
ml_runtime_lee: note for RCA: consider prewarming strategy and reduce model image size; also look at async image pull pipeline and warmup-shards to parallelize KV init.
ops_rotation_noah: leaving a small checklist in the thread for handoff: 1) collect logs (mike) 2) gather warmup traces (lee) 3) customer follow-up notes (arya) 4) write RCA ticket with timeline + runbook changes (jess)
arya_oncall: i'm handing off to night oncall in 15m. leaving current mitigations and status in the runbook. ping me if it regresses. :white_check_mark:
sre_lead_jess: thanks team. I'll kick off the RCA doc and include timeline and hypothesis tracking. closing pager but keeping thread live for postmortem notes. :lock:
